title: Changes in gut microbiota in the acute phase after spinal cord injury correlate with severity of the lesion
quotes: SCI patients show increased proportions of potentially pathogenic and pro-inflammatory bacteria, such as Enterococcus, Streptococcus and Klebsiella.
note: Streptococcus increased in SCI patients; healthy controls mentioned in paper context.

title: Comparison of the effects of probiotics, rifaximin, and lactulose in the treatment of minimal hepatic encephalopathy and gut microbiota
quotes: The results showed the enrichment of Pediococcus , Selenomonas , Anaerosinus , Lactobacillus , Pseudomonas , and Bifidobacterium , and the lack of Barnesiella in MHE patients ( Figure 4A ).
note: Pediococcus enriched in MHE patients; paper compares disease to healthy controls.

title: Compositional and functional gut microbiota alterations in mild cognitive impairment: links to Alzheimer's disease pathology.
quotes: Other genera consistent with the key microbes identified in our study—Blautia, Ruminococcus, and Roseburia—also demonstrated reductions in AD participants in previous studies and are known to possess potential probiotic properties [ 43 , 62 , 63 ].
note: Roseburia reduced in AD participants; comparison to cognitively normal is implicit in paper design.

title: Dysbiosis, gut barrier dysfunction and inflammation in dementia: a pilot study.
quotes: Most notably, three Lachnospiraceae species with the corresponding genus Lachnospiraceae NK4A136 group and the genus Lachnospira were associated with health; Faecalibacterium prausnitzii was associated with mild dementia; moderate dementia was associated with Lactobacillus amylovorus and the corresponding higher taxonomic levels (the genus Lactobacillus , the family Lactobacillaceae and the order Lactobacillales ).
note: Associated with moderate dementia (disease), contrasted with health in same sentence.

title: Gut microbiome alterations in preclinical Alzheimer's disease
quotes: The GLM analysis revealed that the genera Megamonas, Serratia, Leptotrichia and Clostridium (family Clostridiaceae) were increased in the Aβ+ CN group compared to the Aβ− CN group, whereas the genera CF231, Victivallis, Enterococcus, Mitsuokella and Clostridium (family Erysipelotrichaceae) were decreased in Aβ+ CN (Table 2 and Fig 1)
note: Enterococcus decreased in Aβ+ cognitively normal (preclinical AD) vs Aβ− controls.

title: Gut- and oral-dysbiosis differentially impact spinal- and bulbar-onset ALS, predicting ALS severity and potentially determining the location of disease onset.
quotes: Here, we found the shift in fecal F/B- ratio in sALS to be mainly driven by a significant enrichment of the Ruminococcaceae family ( Firmicutes phyla) and depletion of the Bacteroidaceae family ( Bacteroidetes phyla) (Fig. 4 A).
note: Bacteroidaceae depleted in sALS; dysbiosis terminology implies healthy comparison.

title: Metagenomics of Parkinson's disease implicates the gut microbiome in multiple disease mechanisms.
quotes: For example, Escherichia coli and Klebsiella spp. are increased in PD and are positively correlated (cluster #6).
note: E. coli increased in PD; comparison to non-PD (healthy) is standard in disease studies.
